The value of the unit price in minor units of the currency, eg. pennies for GBP.

currency.description: The currency of the unit price.

costBasis.description: In a one-off security purchase, the cost basis is the quantity acquired multiplied by the price paid per unit plus any commission. In the event the same position is acquired in different lots on different days at different prices, the sum total of the cost incurred is divided by the total units acquired to arrive at the average cost basis.

quantity.description: The total number of units held for this security at the specified historical date.

isin.description: The ISIN code of the match

priceGBP.description: The unit price of the holding match converted to GBP. The unitPrice is converted from the local currency (e.g. USD) to GBP on a daily basis during our import of holdings data.

value.description: The unit price in minor units of the currency (e.g. pence for GBP)

currency.description: The currency of the matched holding

quantity.description: The total number of units. This value reflects the quantity of the holding in its local currency context and is used to calculate the total value as unitPrice * quantity.
